summary: HSBC Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K containing statements made at its Annual General Meeting. The filing includes remarks by the Group Chairman and CEO on financial performance, dividend policy, and share buy-backs, as well as a mention of the US$13.7bn privatisation of Hang Seng Bank. However, the filing primarily constitutes routine AGM commentary and strategic updates, not a standalone special-situations event. It is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, with no formal announcement of a transaction requiring separate classification.
